reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, post-fix stale re-review batch 0, 2026-08-02

samples_reviewed.question_text: Write the symbol for the ninth position.
Write the symbol for the seventh position.
Write the symbol for the fifth position.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All six samples ask the student to recall a word-symbol pairing in isolation, e.g. seed 42's 'Which word describes the 1st position?' and seed 44's 'Write the symbol for the ninth position.' -- not one sample places an object in a line, row, or queue for the student to describe, despite the competency's core phrase 'position of objects'.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The six samples cover only 1st, 5th (seeds 43, 50), 7th (seeds 45, 46), and 9th, so more than half of the 1st-to-10th span named in the competency -- 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th itself -- is never generated in this packet.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Both templates, 'Which word describes the Nth position?' and 'Write the symbol for the Nth position.', stay to a single short clause with vocabulary well within Grade 1 Quarter 1 reading ability.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only two task directions appear across all six seeds -- word-given-symbol (seeds 42, 43, 46) and symbol-given-word (seeds 44, 45, 50) -- and no picture-of-a-line, object-in-a-row, or real-world position scenario is ever rendered.

competency_alignment.rationale: The observed variation, e.g. seed 45's 'Write the symbol for the seventh position' versus seed 46's 'Which word describes the 7th position?', is a mirror-image vocabulary drill rather than a progression toward describing where an actual object sits, which is the applied skill the competency names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: No ordinal exceeds the competency's 10th ceiling, and the six samples span from 1st (seed 42) up to 9th (seed 44), covering most of the required 1st-to-10th range even though 10th itself is not among these six seeds.
